live.name: Cron
live.headline: Cron: a threat actor known from a catalogue entry and four tool names
live.in_short: Cron is listed in the ETDA catalogue with four associated tools. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: Cron is a threat actor listed in the ETDA catalogue, which records no other names for it.
The catalogue lists four tools tied to Cron: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot.
No public report in this library describes its operations.

next.headline: Cron: a thinly documented threat actor known mainly by four tool names
next.in_short: The only source for Cron here is a catalogue record. It lists no aliases and four tools: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot. No report in this set describes the actor's targets, methods or operations.

sentences.t: The catalogue record names the actor Cron and lists no aliases.
The record gives its source as ETDA:Cron.
The catalogue record lists four tools for Cron: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot.
This profile is short because the catalogue record is the only source on Cron. Check the original reporting before relying on it.
